title: Weather first, beauty second.
body: Every classic Saudi garment solved heat or cold before it looked good.

title: The bisht's luxury lives on the edge.
body: Plain body, rich front opening and neck.

title: Linen is a hollow stem fiber; wool has scales.
body: Linen: cool, strong, wrinkles. Wool: warm, can scratch, can felt.

title: Real zari = silk or cotton + silver + gold plating.
body: Copper or plastic cores are the cheap copies.

title: Two strips sewn across the middle = hand loom.
body: One wide seamless piece = machine-woven.

title: Fine camel hair is Bactrian; thinner fiber = softer cloth.
body: Ask every supplier for the micron number in writing.

title: Sadu = Bedouin women's ground-loom weaving.
body: Triangles, lines, symmetry, a few strong colors.

title: Al-Qatt is built in named layers.
body: Kufuf (palms) at the bottom, triangles, amshat (combs). Keep the structure, drop the color.

title: Woven-in beats printed for luxury.
body: Dobby for small patterns, jacquard for big ones. Turn it over to check.

title: Najdi triangles = air, light, view, defense.
body: Useful holes that became a pattern. Move 10 turns them into vents.

title: Rawasheen = see out, not in.
body: A wooden garment for the house. Move 11 turns it into a secret lining.

title: Canvas, not glue. Cupro, not polyester.
body: Pinch to check canvas. Half-lined for the Gulf, sleeves always lined.

title: Silver was a woman's bank; bells meant "heard, not seen".
body: Move 13: one silent silver bead, one coral-red stitch.

title: Munaykhal = a sheer "mesh strainer" layer over a solid one.
body: Move 14: open-weave overshirt for men. Najd's grey and navy for both.

title: Momme = silk weight. Light, matte silk for heat.
body: Habotai or crepe under about 16 momme. Charmeuse for evening only.

title: Najran: janbiya and plant-tanned red leather.
body: Move 16: the haskal pocket under the left arm. Move 17: the khabt tab.

title: Scent and pearls are about what's hidden.
body: Oud on the packaging, Taif's al-Arus as a hidden name, red inside like the pearl deal (Move 18).

title: Every fiber in a blend must earn its place.
body: 2–3% elastane max in tailoring. Polyester only for pleats, shells, or a real story.

title: Copy the reason, not the costume.
body: Every Saudi detail solved a problem. Find the problem, and the design follows.

title: One detail, used small, built well.
body: Quiet luxury is a single story you can prove, on a garment made with canvas, cupro and honest fiber.

title: Your brief is a real starting point.
body: Next step: one sample from a pattern-maker, with a fabric swatch in hand.
